title: Request a proof of claim in a probate proceeding | Internal Revenue Service
text: Skip to main content Request a proof of claim in a probate proceeding More In File Individuals Who should file Steps to file your taxes File your tax return Get an extension Amend return Your information Life events Deceased person Students Employees Parents Military Seniors and retirees Businesses and self-employed Charities and nonprofits International taxpayers Governmental liaisons Federal, state and local governments Indian tribal governments Tax exempt bonds Taxpayer identification numbers (TIN) Creditors, including the IRS, can file detailed claims against the estate of a deceased person in probate court. An estate administrator is responsible for contacting creditors who may have a proof of claim. Filing a proof of claim is a time sensitive matter and different courts administer probate proceedings with different deadlines. Send your request for a proof of claim to the IRS Collection Advisory group in the area of the last address of the deceased.
